title: Cost of the potential ZIP-AES2,r attack
summary: A potential ZIP-AES2,r attack requires guessing at least eight key bytes; its data, time, and memory complexities remain to be determined.

formal_statement.body: Optimize the $\mathrm{ZIP\text{-}AES^{\prime}_{4,4}}$ global mixture differential to achieve complexity $<2^{128}$. Additionally, for $\mathrm{ZIP\text{-}AES^{\prime}_{4,4}}$, no comparable global exchange distinguisher has been established: at the current state, setting up such a distinguisher does not seem possible because, for $|I| \leq 2$, the probability that $\operatorname{AES2}(p_0) \oplus \operatorname{AES2}(p_1) = \operatorname{AES2}(p'_0) \oplus \operatorname{AES2}(p'_1)$ belongs to $D_I$ is zero, while $|I| \leq 2$ is required to finish in a non-trivial output subspace. Determine whether a global exchange attack or distinguisher for $\mathrm{ZIP\text{-}AES^{\prime}_{4,4}}$ nevertheless exists, and construct one if possible.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptanalysis of the ZIP-AES2,r construction.
parameters: One first-round-key diagonal and one second-round-key column: key portions that the potential attack must guess
At least eight key bytes: minimum key material guessed by the potential attack
Data, time, and memory: attack-cost measures to be determined
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the data, time, and memory complexity of the potential attack.

citations.label: General Practical Cryptanalysis of the Sum of Round-Reduced Block Ciphers and ZIP-AES

progress.summary: The source describes a potential ZIP-AES2,r attack requiring at least eight guessed key bytes and explicitly leaves estimation of its cost for future work.
citation_labels: Antonio Florez Gutierrez et al., General Practical Cryptanalysis of the Sum of Round-Reduced Block Ciphers and ZIP-AES
